intro: Jordan is mostly desert, with the Jordan Valley and Dead Sea in the west and a short coast on the Red Sea at Aqaba.

chapters.title: Valley, highlands, desert
text: The Jordan Rift Valley runs down the western border to the Dead Sea, the lowest point on land. East of it rise highlands where most people live. The rest, about three-quarters of the country, is desert.
Wadi Rum in the south is a desert of red sand and towering rock mountains.

chapters.title: Water
text: Jordan is one of the most water-scarce countries in the world, and the Dead Sea is shrinking by about a metre a year.

keyTerms.meaning: A long valley formed where the Earth's crust pulls apart.
A dry valley that fills with water after rain.
